projects.name: TenantCore
projects.description: Built a multi-tenant SaaS backend with FastAPI and PostgreSQL. Implemented JWT authentication with role-based access control. Isolated each tenant's data using a tenant id on every table.

projects.name: Job Board API
projects.description: Built a REST API for job listings with search and pagination. Containerised the API and database with Docker Compose. Wrote automated tests with pytest.

projects.name: CareerPilot
projects.description: Built hybrid retrieval combining Postgres full-text search and pgvector with reciprocal rank fusion. Evaluated retrieval with recall and MRR on a labelled golden set. Added an LLM judge that checks generated resume bullets against the source text. Parsed resume PDFs into structured profiles with Gemini structured output.

projects.name: Job Scraper
projects.description: Wrote a Python scraper that collected job postings from public pages. Cleaned and deduplicated the data with pandas. Scheduled the pipeline to run daily with cron.
